title: A US congressional commission report says China's PLA is seeking advanced Nvidia chips for AI-enabled weapons, as domestic chips continue to lag US rivals (Jaspreet Singh/Reuters)
summary: Jaspreet Singh / Reuters: A US congressional commission report says China's PLA is seeking advanced Nvidia chips for AI-enabled weapons, as domestic chips continue to lag US rivals — China's military is seeking advanced Nvidia chips for AI-enabled weapons as Chinese-made processors continue to lag US rivals …
